parts.text: The most talented person in the room is often the one who earns the least.
Robert Kiyosaki once met a journalist in Singapore.
Her writing was excellent. Her novels went nowhere.
He told her to take a course in selling.
She was offended. She had a master's degree in English literature.
So he pointed at her own notes.
Talent alone is rarely enough. You also need the skills that carry it to people.
His advice was simple. Work to learn, not just to earn.
